About ADSHR

Name and meaning

Association for the Development of Schools of High Rank (ADSHR)

The phrase “Schools of High Rank” is metaphorical as well as institutional. ADSHR sees each person as a potential “working institution”: someone whose thinking, character, competence, creativity, and influence can make a meaningful difference. The ambition is to develop people who carry constructive transformation into any profession, institution, family, or community they serve.

ADSHR seeks to make Christ known through transformative education and scientific advancement, developing people of exceptional stature who express God’s purpose through their lives and become agents of transformation wherever they are placed.

Vision

Make Christ known to the world through education.

Mission

Raise individuals with a difference through transformative education, innovative teaching, research and a Christocentric approach to knowledge, skills and values.

Biblical foundation

Romans 1:16 and Isaiah 61:1–4 have been identified as foundational scriptures. Isaiah 61:1–4 also reflects the broader concern for hope, restoration, and transformation.

Values

  • Christ-centred livingFaith shapes purpose, humility, integrity, service, and treatment of others.
  • IntegrityTell the truth, honour commitments, acknowledge mistakes, and use knowledge responsibly.
  • ExcellencePrepare well, pursue accuracy, keep learning, and improve work quality.
  • ServiceUse skills and opportunities to benefit students, colleagues, and communities.
  • CuriosityAsk questions, investigate evidence, and remain teachable.
  • DisciplineBe reliable, prepared, punctual, and consistent.
  • StewardshipUse time, money, equipment, information, and opportunities responsibly.
  • Practical competenceConnect ideas to useful action and real problems.
  • CollaborationShare information, respect others, and take responsibility for shared outcomes.
  • Responsible innovationDevelop solutions with attention to safety, ethics, and social impact.

Transformation

ADSHR is not intended merely to help people pass examinations or accumulate qualifications. Academic achievement matters, but it belongs within a broader formation process.

Strategic objectives

  • Build a credible scientific organisation supporting research, innovation, practical skills, and useful scientific services.
  • Develop Science Modernizers as a transformative educational initiative and, over time, establish a secondary and high school.
  • Create online tutoring and e-learning opportunities, including support for Cameroon GCE students.
  • Build partnerships and a credible public presence.
  • Explore scholarships and other forms of educational access.
  • Develop people whose knowledge, values, character, and practical competence equip them to serve and transform society.

Long-term school ambition

Science Modernizers Secondary and High School is envisioned as a seven-year programme within the Cameroon education context. The intended model combines strong STEM learning with practical knowledge, hands-on skills, character and values, leadership development, and Christ-centred formation.

The future school and scientific/skills initiatives are long-term ambitions, not claims that they already operate.

Team

ADSHR has a 20-person Christian team, including two co-founders.

Both co-founders are engineers. One is strong in vision and content creation, particularly YouTube. The other is strong in leadership and organisation, content creation, and tutoring, and is also a teacher by profession.

ADSHR central coordination oversees the whole organisation and may lead cross-branch or special projects, while branches and programme teams manage specialised activities.

Online GCE Science Support

Science Modernizers has a history of free GCE A-Level classes in Yaoundé, an online community, and digital channels.

Provide accessible online academic support for students preparing for Cameroon’s GCE Advanced Level in science, while encouraging disciplined learning habits, integrity, responsibility, curiosity, and Christ-centred character.

DeliveryOnline only
ReachStudents across Cameroon
LevelGCE Advanced Level science

Subjects

Planning may include Mathematics, Further Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, and other relevant subjects where competent tutors are available.

Launch date and final subject coverage remain to be confirmed.

Join as a Student

The learning cycle

  1. 01
    Registration and needs identificationSubjects requested, class/exam session, preferred times, access needs, and contact method.
  2. 02
    Initial diagnosticA short activity to understand the learner’s starting point.
  3. 03
    Teaching and guided practiceScheduled lessons aligned with syllabus content and examination demands.
  4. 04
    Independent practiceExercises, worksheets, notes, or recommended tasks.
  5. 05
    Question support and feedbackA defined channel and response expectation.
  6. 06
    Follow-up assessmentReview progress and identify topics needing more support.

Online access and character

Online-only delivery should not mean video-only delivery. Students may have limited data, unstable connections, or shared devices. Where feasible, use WhatsApp for coordination and share low-bandwidth notes and exercises.

Tutors should model discipline, honesty, perseverance, respect, curiosity, and service.

Join the Team

A foundational criterion for joining ADSHR is that a person is Christian.

  • Christian faith and Christ-centred characterMembers should seek to live with integrity, humility, love, discipline, service, teachability, and accountability.
  • Capacity to nurture transformationMembers should show maturity, empathy, willingness, and/or experience that helps others grow intellectually, morally, socially, spiritually, emotionally, or professionally, within appropriate boundaries.
  • Relevant competence and a spirit of excellenceMembers should bring useful skills, knowledge, experience, or a credible willingness to develop them.
  • Commitment and collaborationMembers should understand the mission, communicate honestly, and carry agreed responsibilities.

ADSHR welcomes a science and innovation orientation, including medicine, engineering, teaching, research, and technology. Marketing, communications, design, finance, administration, and other strengths are also necessary.
